details: Bitcoin's recent rally is on "thin ice," according to Glassnode, due to thin liquidity and aggressive sellers outnumbering buyers, despite prices hovering around $63,000. The 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) has entered overbought territory, and spot trading volume has dropped by 21.5%. Retail sentiment on Stocktwits has turned bearish, with over $250 million in leveraged crypto positions liquidated in the past day, primarily long positions.
title: Bitcoin Rally Faces "Trust Problem" Amid Weak Liquidity

details: Nasdaq-listed Empery Digital has sold approximately 1,400 BTC, generating around $87.1 million since May, effectively reducing its Bitcoin holdings by nearly half. The proceeds will be used to fund a $65 million investment in an AI data center project, repay $10 million in outstanding debt, and cover legal and operational expenses. This move signifies a strategic pivot away from its prior Bitcoin-centric treasury strategy.
title: Empery Digital Offloads Half BTC Treasury for AI Data Center & Debt

details: Webull Europe has secured regulatory approval under the European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework from the Dutch regulator. This makes it one of the first major firms to be authorized following the conclusion of the MiCA transition period on July 1. The approval allows Webull to launch crypto trading and custody services across the EU by late 2026, starting with the Netherlands and expanding through passporting.
title: Webull EU Gains MiCA Approval for Crypto Services Launch

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) recorded $197 million in net inflows during the week of July 6-10, ending an eight-week streak of persistent outflows. Similarly, spot Ethereum ETFs also attracted $84.42 million in inflows, breaking their own eight-week outflow run. This indicates a potential return of institutional demand after a prolonged period of redemptions.
title: US Spot Bitcoin ETFs See $197M Inflows, Snap Eight-Week Outflow Streak

details: Uniswap is currently generating over $5 million in daily fees, with data from DefiLlama confirming approximately $5.16 million in the past 24 hours. This significant surge is largely attributed to activity on Robinhood Chain, which accounts for the majority of the fee flow, primarily driven by meme coin trading rather than tokenized stocks. Furthermore, governance votes are underway to expand UNI token burns.
title: Uniswap Daily Fees Hit $5.2M, Driven by Robinhood Chain Activity
